_comment: Configuration of scripts/third-party-inventory.py. 'allowed' lists the licenses a dependency may use without a review; extend it only with a reason in 'allowed_why'.
title: Third-party dependencies of the server
intro: Every crate the workspace pins in `Cargo.lock`, for the platforms the server is built for (Linux and Windows, x86-64). Nothing else is bundled: the SQLite library comes inside the `libsqlite3-sys` crate (SQLite itself is in the public domain). Why each direct dependency is there: the README, "Dependencies".

cargo.label: Rust crates
cargo.note: "runtime": linked into one of the programs; "build": used only while compiling; "dev": tests only.

allowed_why: Permissive licenses compatible with the project's MIT License. MPL-2.0 is a file-level license: a crate under it is used unmodified from crates.io, and a change to one of its files would have to be published under MPL-2.0.
